The harbor service queue SLA audit task succeeded with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust implementation of the required auditing logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to AWS-based runtimes. The results were successfully serialized to a JSON result file after a 5-minute total runtime.
